title: Input-length counting machine
statement: For an input over an arbitrary symbol alphabet, the input-length machine is a deterministic machine with one work tape over the Boolean alphabet and the six phases for counting, carry propagation, moving back, returning to the input, scanning back across it, and completion. Its transition function performs the corresponding input and work-tape actions in each phase.
